# Meshtastic messenger for the Elecrow CrowPanel Advance 10.1" ESP32-P4
# (1024x600) with the Elecrow SX1262 LoRa module in the wireless socket.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

# components/: CrowPanel BSP (bsp_i2c, bsp_display, bsp_illuminate, bsp_extra)
# and meshtastic_node. The UI is generated by EEZ Studio into main/ui/.
set(EXTRA_COMPONENT_DIRS "components")

include($ENV{IDF_PATH}/tools/cmake/project.cmake)
project(elecrow-10_1-meshtastic)
